title: BusinessHours - Data API
description: Specifies the business hours of your support organization. Escalation rules are run only during these hours.

BusinessHoursId.description: ID of the BusinessHours associated with the SlaProcess.

IsActive.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
IsActive.description: Indicates whether the business hours is active (true) or not active (false).

Name.properties: Create, Filter, Group, idLookup, Sort, Update
Name.description: The name of the business hours.

IsDefault.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
IsDefault.description: Indicates whether the business hours are set as the default business hours (true) or not (false).

LastViewedDate.description: The date when the business hours were last viewed.

TimeZoneSidKey.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
TimeZoneSidKey.description: The time zone of the business hours.

special_access_rules: All users, even those without the “View Setup and Configuration” user permission, can view business hours via the API.
usage:
Use this object to specify the business hours at which your support team operates. Escalation rules only run during the business hours with which they are associated. To set business hours to 24-hours a day, set the times from midnight to midnight (00:00:00 ~ 00:00:00) on each day. By default, business hours are set from 12:00 AM to 12:00 AM in the default time zone specified in your organization's profile.
